name: Tide of Life
description: Life influence spreads across the realm. Nurture growth and vitality.

stages.description: Life reaches 30% influence in at least 2 regions.

conditions.description: Life sphere influence at 0.3+ in 2+ regions

stages.description: Life reaches 40% influence in at least 4 regions.

conditions.description: Life sphere influence at 0.4+ in 4+ regions

stages.description: Life reaches 50% influence in at least 6 regions. Vitality dominates.

conditions.description: Life sphere influence at 0.5+ in 6+ regions

prose.setup_to_escalation: Life blooms where it withered. Two regions flourish under your touch. Growth spreads like whispered prayer through barren soil.
prose.escalation_to_culmination: Four territories sing with vitality. Forests deepen their green. Animals return. The world remembers fertility. Life rides your current now.
prose.completed: Six regions blaze with the force of growth. The Tide of Life has become a torrent. Creation itself bends to your will. Entropy retreats before you.
prose.failed: The life force withdraws. Regions relapse into drought and silence. Your dominion over growth was illusory. The world is larger than you.
